description: This file defines the base class 'PdfObject' for all composite PDF objects within the PDFsharp library. It includes constructors, cloning, equality checks, object ID management, and internal methods for handling PDF object references and internal structure.

classes.name: PdfObject
classes.description: An abstract base class for all composite objects in a PDF document, providing core functionalities such as cloning, ID management, and internal structure handling.

methods.name: PdfObject
methods.description: Parameterless constructor for initializing a new PdfObject instance.

methods.name: PdfObject
methods.description: Constructor initializing the object with a reference to the owning PdfDocument.

methods.name: PdfObject
methods.description: Copy constructor used for object type transformation, linking the new object to the original's owner.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the PdfObject.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Internal method implementing the copying logic, to be overridden in derived classes.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Overrides object equality to consider object references and indirect reference targets.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Overrides GetHashCode to return hash based on the indirect reference if present.

methods.name: SetObjectID
methods.description: Assigns an object ID to this object, making it an indirect object within the PDF.

methods.name: Owner
methods.description: Returns the PdfDocument that owns this object.

methods.name: Document
methods.description: Internal setter for associating the object with a PdfDocument.

methods.name: PrepareForSave
methods.description: Prepares the object to be saved into a PDF stream; meant to be overridden.

methods.name: WriteObject
methods.description: Method for serializing the object to a PDF stream; should be overridden in derived classes.

methods.name: ObjectID
methods.description: Returns the object ID if the object is indirect, or an empty ID if direct.

methods.name: ObjectNumber
methods.description: Returns the object number part of the object ID.

methods.name: GenerationNumber
methods.description: Returns the generation number part of the object ID.

methods.name: DeepCopyClosure
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an object and its transitive closure, remapping references to a new owner document.

methods.name: ImportClosure
methods.description: Imports an object and its transitive closure from an external PDF document into the owner document.

methods.name: FixUpObject
methods.description: Recursively replaces references to external objects with local cloned counterparts within a given PDF object.

methods.name: DebugCheckNonObjects
methods.description: Debug helper to ensure only expected item types are processed.

methods.name: Reference
methods.description: Gets the indirect reference of this object, if any.

methods.name: ReferenceNotNull
methods.description: Gets the indirect reference, throwing an exception if it is null.
